snippet.title: Inversed (Visual Novel) - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
itch.io: https://tymedust.itch.io/inversed

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Tymedust

In the mid-19th Century, a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life.

Poetry is the answer. But what is the question?

* 1,000 words (10-15 minutes of playtime)!
* Fully voiced!
* Animated mid-19th Century poet/goth girl!
* Choose words and create mysterious poems (minigame style)!
* Atmospheric narrative (lights out and headset on for maximum effect)!
